known_risks.detail: GitHub Checks were not used as runtime truth; the post-merge exact runtime suite is the available execution evidence plane.

lessons_learned: Python 3.14 sqlite3 context-manager usage does not close connections; operation-scoped connections require explicit closing.
Durable recovery mutations require explicit commits when operation-scoped connections are used.
Test-side SQLite lifecycle must be audited separately from persistent production stores.
Runtime evidence must remain distinct from merge authority.
